title: The Ranks of Global Billionaires: Not All Billionaires Are Made Equal
summary: An Economics Explained video on the different kinds of billionaires, from founders to oligarchs. It explains how wealth is held in illiquid stock and why diversification is a problem for some.
why: HN recommends it to explain why comparing billionaire net worth by share price is misleading.

quote.text: fyi youtube video of why these simplistic comparisons of "net worth" based on shares-times-stockprice is meaningless
